question: Kani/Verus RAM (R-FORMAL-2): do representative F5 obligations (Kani: TBI-9 RST bucket, GCRA TAT update and I1 window bound; Verus: permit ledger with ghost multiset) fit a 6 GB CI cap, and does Kani fail closed on OOM?
flips_if: Reverse R-FORMAL-2 if a golden obligation needs Mathlib, or Verus peak RAM on the first 10 obligations exceeds 16 GB; R-FORMAL-3 step 8 requires Kani main >= PR #4910 with OOM/timeout => FAIL

decision_effect: R-FORMAL-2 unchanged: 6 GB CI cap fits every measured obligation with >2.8x headroom (largest peak 2.09 GB was a deliberately heavy 32-element sort; real F5 obligations <= 0.37 GB). No obligation needs a bigger runner for RAM; Verus is >40x below the 16 GB flip threshold on its first obligation. The binding limit is solver TIME, not RAM. Amend R-FORMAL-3 / VERIFICATION_PLAN §3: (8) 'Kani: main commit >= PR #4910 checked by git ancestry of the recorded commit (main still reports version 0.68.0, so the version string cannot tell it from the broken release); serial; 6 GB cap; 30 min per-harness timeout; CBMC exit not in {0,10}, OOM or timeout => FAIL (executed: 0 false passes in 4 OOM/timeout runs)'. (9) replace '-V check-erasure' (not an option in 0.2026.10.18) with 'erasure check is on by default; deny --no-erasure-check'. New obligation-shape rule for Kani (F5 row, VERIFICATION_PLAN §2): 'Kani obligations are single-step inductive lemmas over symbolic state; window bounds are stated in emission-time units (ghost credit += T*cost), never as an unrolled trace and never needing T*(a+b) = T*a + T*b; nonlinear symbolic*symbolic arithmetic only with one factor <= 8 bits.' Disk: Verus CI install is 2.2 GB (REPO_LAYOUT §1 says 3.16 GB, which is now an upper bound including the zip); Kani 2.25 GB runtime + 1.1 GB build tree.
rung: measurement grade B (LAN box standing in for CI; one host); harness results are R1-style model checks of spike harnesses, not of AEGIS code
reproduce: on kamrui: ~/aegis-ci/bin/setup-toolchains.sh; ~/aegis-ci/bin/build-kani.sh; ~/aegis-ci/bin/run-kani.sh [harness...]; ~/aegis-ci/bin/run-verus.sh; ROUND=1 ~/aegis-ci/bin/oom-test.sh; ROUND=2 ~/aegis-ci/bin/oom-test.sh; ~/aegis-ci/bin/scale-gcra.sh (sources in spikes/q2-013/scripts, harnesses in spikes/q2-013/harness, work dir ~/aegis-ci/work/q2-013)
limits: 4 Kani + 1 Verus obligations, not the first 10 real ones; the Verus ledger is small (no maps, no per-connection collection), so Verus RAM on large ledgers stays an estimate. The #4905 false pass of release 0.68.0 was not reproduced as a control (0.68.0 not installed); fail-closed behaviour is shown for the pinned main build only. The ulimit path shows CBMC's own 'Out of memory' handling but whether CBMC exited 6 is inferred from Kani's message, not logged separately. CPU contention: some timed runs overlapped with one other CBMC job on the 4-core box (wall times are upper bounds). Kani's RSS figure is dominated by kani-compiler; CBMC's own peak is bounded by the cgroup peak.
